csv_project_name: Design For Historic Shuffleboard Clubhouse Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Saint Pete Beach ( City ) is seeking qualified Proposers to provide design, permitting and construction services for the replacement of the Shuffleboard Clubhouse ( Project Site ). The Project Site was impacted by Hurricane Helene on September 26th, 2024 and by Hurricane Milton on October 9th, 2024. The Project Site is located south of 10th Avenue and west of Pass-a-Grille Way at 101 9th Avenue in Saint Pete Beach, Florida. The structure was nationally registered as historic. The project aims to restore the Project Site s historical character, support shuffleboard recreation, accommodate passive park and small community gatherings, ensure public safety, and comply with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering

title: Design for Historic Shuffleboard Clubhouse Replacement
short_description: Design-build replacement of a historic shuffleboard clubhouse damaged by hurricanes in St. Pete Beach.
project_location: 101 9th Avenue, St. Pete Beach, Florida, USA
project_scope: Replacement of the historic Shuffleboard Clubhouse at a site south of 10th Avenue and west of Pass-a-Grille Way in St. Pete Beach, Florida. The existing nationally registered historic structure was impacted by Hurricane Helene on September 26, 2024 and Hurricane Milton on October 9, 2024. The project is intended to restore the site's historical character, support shuffleboard recreation, accommodate passive park use and small community gatherings, ensure public safety, and comply with applicable local, state, and federal regulations. No gross floor area or other dimensional data are stated.
services: Design, permitting, and construction services under a design-build procurement; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Small general building project with stated construction cost of only 170,000 USD.
- Primarily architectural/design-build scope for a clubhouse replacement; no notable structural complexity or long-span elements described.
- Historic context may require sensitive design, but the tender does not emphasize innovative structural engineering.
- Not a bridge, stadium, long-span roof, major cultural building, or large/complex building of typical high interest to sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost $170.0K.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated in the tender documents. With a very small total construction cost of 170,000 USD and a design-build scope, any structural engineering fee would likely be limited, but no reliable standalone sbp fee can be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualified proposers are sought to provide design, permitting, and construction services. Requested disciplines: architecture services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, and civil engineering. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
